question: How many novel, globally de-duplicated Grade-A model review events can be mined from completed daily Top5-gainer and Top5-loser boards before detector validation and holdout, stopping only after a full-month boundary reaches at least 5,000?

requests: 为了继续优化我们的模型训练，我们继续优化数据集，用模型 跑每天的涨跌幅排行榜前几的 跑一遍
多少个？起码要给我找5000个啊
owner_authorization.interpreted_action: Scale the daily-mover P1 mining pool until at least 5,000 globally de-duplicated novel model review events are available; retain candidate-positive, hard-negative and training-overlap identities separately and do not call them confirmed Gold.

calendar.stop_rule: After each complete month, globally de-duplicate all accumulated events and stop at the first month boundary where novelty_status=new_event_review count is at least 5000.
calendar.why_latest_is_2025_10: October ends before the current detector's first validation input at 2025-12-02T22:00:00Z; the nine post-day endpoint bars can use 2025-11 context without entering validation or holdout.

ranking.daily_return: last confirmed 15m close / first confirmed 15m open - 1
ranking.gainer_sort: daily_return descending, exchange_symbol ascending tie break
ranking.loser_sort: daily_return ascending, exchange_symbol ascending tie break
ranking.prohibited_interpretation: The completed-day board is not a live universe selector, feature, backtest, return baseline or trading signal.

detector.discovery_view_reason: The prior October audit showed W18 alone retained 214/255 de-duplicated events and 36/39 semantic events while halving rendering/inference work. This is a preregistered discovery sampler, not a detector comparison or performance claim; confirmed events can later receive both views under a separately approved dataset build.

causal_prefilter.definition: minimum over the visible W18 bars of (max of SMA/EMA 20/60/120 minus min of SMA/EMA 20/60/120) divided by causal Pine-RMA ATR14
causal_prefilter.source: same numeric envelope ceiling as the frozen semantic gate
causal_prefilter.october_efficiency_audit: On the already-completed 2025-10 scan, W18 plus this prefilter retained 114/214 W18 review events and all 36/36 W18 semantic events while retaining 6,987/31,549 W18 endpoints. This retrospective calibration is disclosed and is used only to reduce candidate-mining compute.

detector.event_attribution: mapped core-end bar must lie inside the ranked UTC day

semantic_gate.paired_null: Recompute every structural box with LONG and SHORT flipped while keeping candles, box, endpoint and thresholds fixed.

training_overlap_audit.exact_input_identity: same venue, exchange symbol, window start/end and window length, then decoded training-image pixel SHA-256 equals the replayed inference input pixel SHA-256
training_overlap_audit.same_positive_event: same Binance symbol and model direction with core-end distance below five 15m bars from an existing positive event
training_overlap_audit.global_event_dedup: same exchange symbol with adjacent core-end timestamps less than five bars apart, including UTC-day and month boundaries

remote_cuda.role: inference-only renderer plus raw normalized YOLO box producer; Mac remains authoritative for ranks, mapping, semantic decisions, overlap, deduplication and artifacts
remote_cuda.mac_cuda_pixel_parity: Every remote task with one or more raw boxes is re-rendered on Mac; decoded BGR SHA-256 and ChartTransform must exactly match before the box is admitted.

interpretation.purpose: P1 human-review queue and dataset coverage audit
interpretation.five_thousand_means: at least 5,000 globally de-duplicated model-proposed events outside exact/near training-positive overlap, not 5,000 confirmed positives
must_disclose: same-day mover membership is known only after the UTC day closes
the search ends before detector validation and holdout, so this is candidate mining rather than model evaluation
model boxes and semantic-gate passes are proposals, not Owner-confirmed Gold
the W18/envelope discovery sampler is calibrated from the prior October audit and is not a completeness claim
current archive membership may contain survivorship and contract-availability bias
